decisions.reason: The original ios H1 baseline pixel coverage shows title, subtitle, notice, all six labels/details and unavailable reasons, the no-selection summary and collapsed disclosure, Request station and the complete footer. In this RTL enlarged text layout every required word continues into readable wrapped lines without ellipsis, hidden suffixes or clipped characters. Capture-edge cuts continue in overlapping originals.

Across the complete bound ios H1 baseline content sweep, header and notice, the six choice labels/details/reasons, summary, disclosure, primary action and footer occupy separate vertical/card regions. No text, status word, card content or action occludes another item. Viewport edge fragments are covered by adjacent original frames.

The original ios H1 expanded pixel coverage shows title, subtitle, notice, all six labels/details and unavailable reasons, the selected a draft summary, open disclosure label and complete global guidance, Request station and the complete footer. In this RTL enlarged text layout every required word continues into readable wrapped lines without ellipsis, hidden suffixes or clipped characters. Capture-edge cuts continue in overlapping originals.

Across the complete bound ios H1 expanded content sweep, header and notice, the six choice labels/details/reasons, summary, disclosure, expanded guidance, primary action and footer occupy separate vertical/card regions. No text, status word, card content or action occludes another item. Viewport edge fragments are covered by adjacent original frames.

Inspected all bound submitted captures [69, 70, 71, 72, 73, 74]; captured text is readable and no unintended collision is evident. Exact-state full-content coverage is nevertheless incomplete: interval union ends at 1900 of 1905.67 native content units (incomplete per-state interval union). The required whole-state wrapping proposition stays unknown; a visible footer/sentinel does not repair this coverage gap.
